curated.tagline: Role-aligned application demos — Deflect, Motion, Bakeoff, Caesar
curated.description: Four OpenRouter application demos in github.com/duketopceo/openrouter-demos: Deflect (support classify/deflect/escalate with Guardrails), Motion (GTM inbound → next action with Auto Router), Bakeoff (provider ops — latency, cost, quality launch gate), and Caesar (two-model debate with concession traces). Offline pytest passes on fixtures; live evals require OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

film.transcript: A walkthrough of the role-aligned application demos: Deflect, Motion, Bakeoff and Caesar.

highlights: Deflect — support routing with Guardrails and eval fixtures
Motion — GTM next-action with Auto Router and presets
Bakeoff — provider comparison and launch-gate scoring
Caesar — debate traces with concession rules
curated.architecture: OpenRouter routing → Role-specific eval harness → Guardrails / presets → Launch-gate scoring
